project_info.aesthetic_archetype: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day / Auramax Acoustic Hardware Aesthetic
project_info.description: High-fidelity audiobook distribution platform combining studio-grade audio engineering aesthetic with editorial typography, kinetic motion, and acoustic visualizers.

typography.font_strategy: High-contrast architectural typography mixing ultra-bold geometric sans with delicate editorial serifs and technical mono elements.

fonts.heading_serif_accent: Instrument Serif, serif / Cormorant Garamond, serif

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[0.95]
scale.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none

rules: NEVER use Inter or Roboto for main and sub-headings.
Always apply tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) on text above 32px.
Use technical overlines in uppercase mono with high tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Never use pure #000000 background; use tinted deep charcoal #0A0A0C.
Gradients reserved for micro-accents, glowing borders, and visualizer elements (<15% total surface area).
High contrast WCAG AA / APCA standards maintained for all interactive elements.

glassmorphism.nav_header: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0A0A0C]/80 border-b border-white/10 z-50 fixed top-0 w-full

surface_strategies.tracing_beam: Glowing 1px moving gradient border on hover for featured audiobook cards and waitlist container.
surface_strategies.grid_borders: Exposed technical skeleton grids using border-white/10 for specs and pricing breakdown.

craft_and_interactions.lenis_scrolling: Smooth momentum Lenis scroll engine integrated globally on root element.
craft_and_interactions.kinetic_hero_reveal: Signature line-by-line masked entrance reveal on page load using Framer Motion staggered clip-paths.
craft_and_interactions.editorial_marquee: Infinite smooth low-speed text ticker featuring 'BOOKLAB AUDIO • HIGH-FIDELITY IMMERSION • CURATED NARRATION • STUDIO GRADE NARRATIVE SYNTHESIS • 320KBPS UNCOMPRESSED'.
craft_and_interactions.acoustic_3d_visualizer: Interactive HTML5 Canvas / R3F dynamic audio wave visualizer responding to preview playback in hero and featured audiobooks.
craft_and_interactions.spotlight_photo_treatment: Hardware-style spotlight ray effect and clipped titanium frame borders around narrator and cover art showcases.

hero_section.headline: Acoustic Perfection Meets Literary Greatness.
hero_section.subheadline: Immerse yourself in masterfully narrated audiobooks, engineered for high-fidelity spatial listening.

key_features_and_content.waitlist_feature: Interactive VIP Early-Access form collecting email, listening preference (Headphones, Hi-Fi Speakers, Commute), with immediate confetti toast feedback.
key_features_and_content.member_area_my_shelf: Interactive portal featuring: Currently Listening (with interactive progress, audio player widget, playback speed 0.8x-2.0x), Saved Wishlist, Monthly Credit Balance badge (1 Credit / Month), and Claim Next Book option ($8.99).

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, links, and key indicators MUST contain descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_for_main_agent: Install and verify lenis smooth scroll or import Lenis for high-end scroll feeling.
Ensure the hero section features a masked line-by-line reveal with Framer Motion and an audio wave canvas visualizer.
Create an interactive audio drawer or modal player so users can listen to actual audio samples from any of the 8 books.
Provide a sleek modal/drawer for 'My Shelf' with local storage persistence for saved/purchased books.
Ensure pricing ($1.99 first 3 months, $8.99 after, 1 choice/mo + $8.99 additions) is highlighted in a high-density bento grid.
All interactive elements must have clear focus, hover, and active states with appropriate data-testid attributes.
